subject: Exhibit reclassification & SOW rewrite — SKU tiering and pricing impact
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@bluebayhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluebayhealth.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft SOW (v2) - SKU reclassification request

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the demo last week. BlueBay procurement and engineering reviewed the capable options and we have an internal ask: rather than a reserved-GPU SKU, we want the Exhibit B to define capacity as a per-concurrent-request (PCR) SKU for the inference endpoints, and to alter the SOW language to reflect a usage-based measurement with a 30-day moving window.

High level:
- Reclassify Exhibit B pricing blocks to PCR (instead of reserved vGPU hours).
- Add language in the SOW that clarifies our shared responsibility for input data retention (BlueBay vs Redwood).
- We would like a 10% volume-based discount at 12-month commit or a blended fee if we ramp slower.

I've attached a redlined SOW v2 with inline notes (BBH_SOW_v2_20270714.docx). Our procurement counsel (Ellen Santos, cc'd) will expect a track-changes version and a short memo on risk for any indemnity/PD clauses.

Can you confirm a targeted timeline for legal redlines and whether this triggers a pricing rework? We are hoping to finalize amendment + PO by the end of July.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Director, Strategic Sourcing
BlueBay Health
[Attachment: BBH_SOW_v2_20270714.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft SOW (v2) - SKU reclassification request

Rishi / Jonas — forwarding BlueBay's request. Key asks: move Exhibit B billing to PCR units, update SOW for retention responsibilities, and consider a 10% volume discount at 12-month commit.

Rishi: can you assess pricing impact and whether we need to propose an alternate blending? If GB/FF (gross bill) drops materially, flag the minimum guarantee implications.

Jonas: can you review the attached SOW and Ellen's note for any high-risk language (indemnities, data residency, audit rights). BlueBay wants a track-changes back to them; they called an end-of-July target for an amendment + PO.

I think this is a fairly standard reclassification but want legal signoff on the data retention clause. Please reply with: (a) redline timeline, (b) suggested contract language (if any), and (c) whether finance needs to alter billing terms.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ellen Santos <ellen.santos@sglegal.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Draft SOW (v2) - SKU reclassification request

Mina —

I've reviewed the SOW and top-line comments below. I attached a draft amendment (MSA_Amendment_Draft_JW.pdf) that updates Exhibit B pricing references and adds the PCR definition.

Legal highlights / recommended edits:
1) Definition (low effort): add a defined term "Concurrent Request Unit (CRU)" mapped to endpoint concurrency and rate limits. Keep billing meter simple: "number of concurrent active inference requests averaged over a 30-day rolling window."
2) Data retention: replace "Redwood will retain input payloads for X days" with a split clause: "Redwood will retain transient logs for up to 7 days for debugging; persistent storage is only used if customer opts in via data retention addendum." This reduces exposure for us.
3) Indemnity: BlueBay requested expanded indemnity for third-party claims related to PHI. We can offer a limited carveout: Redwood indemnifies for Redwood-controlled negligence; customer retains liability for customer-provided data. Ellen: please confirm if BlueBay counsel will accept a carveout like this.
4) Audit rights: propose a quarterly, scoped audit with 7-day notice rather than open access.
5) Effective date flow: amendment effective once DocuSign and PO accepted.

Timeline: I can produce a redline for BlueBay within 48 hours if no major changes from sales/finance. If you want tracked changes directly in their Word doc, I'll prepare both PDF and DOCX.

Attachment: MSA_Amendment_Draft_JW.pdf

Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MSA_Amendment_Draft_JW.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Draft SOW (v2) - SKU reclassification request / Pricing impact

Mina / Jonas —

Quick pricing take after modeling: switching to PCR (CRU) changes our unit economics but can be neutral if we: (a) add a short-term ramp guardrail (blended floor for first 3 months), and (b) require a minimum monthly invoice (MMI) that covers 60% of estimated baseline usage for the first 12 months.

I attached a short model (Pricing_Tier_Impact_0705.xlsx) with two scenarios: conservative ramp and aggressive ramp. Summary:
- Aggressive ramp: expected ARR up 8% vs reserved SKU (because customers scale into PCR).
- Conservative ramp: ARR flat but lower gross margin first quarter without MMI.

Proposal: offer the 10% volume discount after 12 months OR on a blended schedule: 5% after month 6, 10% at month 12, subject to hit-rate. Also require an MMI for the first 12 months to protect unit economics.

Next steps: if legal accepts the data-retention carve and limited audit, I'll prepare final pricing language for the amendment. I can sync with finance (Grace) if needed before sending to BlueBay.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Solutions & Pricing
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Pricing_Tier_Impact_0705.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@bluebayhealth.com>, Ellen Santos <ellen.santos@sglegal.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Finalizing amendment: next steps and DocuSign

Marta / Ellen —

Thanks for the prompt review and for flagging business preferences. Quick recap of what we're planning to deliver by Friday, 23 Jul: 
- Redwood will provide: (1) tracked redline of the SOW and MSA amendment (Jonas), (2) pricing addendum with MMI and ramp/blend schedule (Rishi), and (3) a clean DocuSign package with amendment + updated Exhibit B.
- BlueBay to provide: PO referencing deal BBH-2027-045 and confirmation of the 12-month billing start date.

Ellen — please confirm if the indemnity carve (Redwood indemnifies for Redwood-controlled negligence; BlueBay retains for customer-supplied PHI) is acceptable — we can fold any final edits into the redline.

I've prepared an initial DocuSign envelope and will populate it once we have the final redline and pricing sheet. Link (preview): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/12345-BlueBay-EXH?env=prod

If all good, I'll send the envelope and copy procurement. 

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
